facts: No snow or storms in the forecast this week; highs near 78°F at pass elevation.

avalanche.travel_advice: Watch for signs of unstable snow such as recent avalanches, cracking in the snow, and audible collapsing. Avoid traveling on or under similar slopes.

facts: No new snow measured at the 3 nearby stations in the 72 hours to Sep 28.

facts.text: Snow left Billie Creek Divide (5,280 ft) 44 days earlier this year than the median of the three earlier seasons on file (2023 to 2025).

evidence.name: Billie Creek Divide
evidence.detail: left April 3; earlier seasons: May 23 (2023), May 17 (2024), May 13 (2025)

facts.text: At Billie Creek Divide (5,280 ft), this year's highest snow water on or after April 1 was 0.8 in, the lowest of the four seasons on file (2023 to 2026).

evidence.name: Billie Creek Divide
evidence.detail: 0.8 in on April 2; earlier seasons: 34.8 in (2023), 29.1 in (2024), 31.1 in (2025)

facts.text: An estimate: snow left the pass itself between February 26 and April 19, carried from the melt-out date at Billie Creek Divide (5,280 ft) to the pass elevation.

evidence.name: Billie Creek Divide
evidence.detail: melted out April 3, 579 ft above the pass; points to February 26 to April 19
